notes.heading: What turns in the Mount Top's bearing
notes.text: The circular spline. The Mount Top's 6810 takes the spline's Ø50h6 outside diameter over the spline's top {top_6810_on_spline} mm. The spline turns with the Stator Holder and the External Gear, so this bearing is the output's third support.

notes.heading: How J3's stack closes
notes.text: Three revised prints close the motor chain on the output chain: the End Cap, the Attach, and the Stator Holder, whose floor keeps the drive where the first two put it. The coupler's 5.0 spacing (DC-600-2) splits 1.0 motor-down, which is all the lower 6810 leaves the motor's corners, and 4.0 drive-up, on a boss of the holder's that rises into the top 6810's bore. The drop follows the motor body: measure it (008.3), set MOTOR_LEN, and print J3's Attach with the new j3_hub_drop.

notes.heading: The coupler
notes.text: The Wave Gen Coupler (#630-004) turns with the motor's shaft, inside every part that stands still about it: the Attach, the M2 hub screws, the flexspline's hub and the Flex Spline Cap, each the running clearance off it. It runs from over the motor's boss to just under the wave generator, whose bore takes its Ø6 stub past the set screws; an M3 grub screw in a captured nut grips the shaft's flat, reached through the Attach's access hole on +Y (DC-600-2).

notes.heading: The tie-down
notes.text: Each all-thread stands on its Nut Holder's slot floor, through the trap nut, up through the Mount and the Mount Top, two nuts locked on top. Four M3 × 10 screws come up through the floor's counterbores into the End Cap's nuts; an M3 × 12 would reach the lowered motor.
